title: simbasjungles/free-my-tv
why_read: Similar to the other TV launcher tool, this is a practical ad-removal utility for mainstream smart TV platforms with modest technical depth but clear everyday utility.
analysis: This is another ad-free home screen replacement, this time targeting Google TV, LG webOS, and Samsung Tizen platforms, which are more globally common than the China-specific tool above. The notable feature is a one-button undo, suggesting attention to safe reversibility, a good practical design choice for consumer software. Like the other launcher project, the technical ambition is modest, centered on UI replacement and bypassing manufacturer bloatware rather than novel engineering. It is useful chiefly as a consumer-facing utility rather than as a source of new technical ideas.
